def run_simulation():
    n, k = map(int, input().split())
    probs = list(map(float, input().split()))
    for i in range(n):
        if abs(probs[i]) < 1e-6:
            print("0 ", end='')
            continue
        m = n - 1
        dp = [0.0] * (1 << m)
        others = [probs[j] for j in range(n) if j != i]
        dp[0] = probs[i]
        total = dp[0]
        for mask in range(1, 1 << m):
            sumP = 0.0
            sumVal = 0.0
            cnt = 0
            for t in range(m):
                if mask & (1 << t):
                    sumP += others[t]
                    sumVal += others[t] * dp[mask ^ (1 << t)]
                    cnt += 1
            dp[mask] = sumVal / (1 - sumP)
            if cnt < k:
                total += dp[mask]
        print(f"{total} ", end='')

n_tests = 1
for _ in range(n_tests):
    run_simulation()
